summary: The Jewish Autonomous Oblast stands under the national framework of Russia. No law, enforcement action, institution or incident specific to the oblast appears in the sources reviewed, so the national assessment for Russia applies to visitors here.
tangentialFactors: Neither source in the inventory compares the Jewish Autonomous Oblast with any other Russian region, and no regional-level enforcement or incident data for the oblast was located.
localsOnly: No resident-facing information specific to the Jewish Autonomous Oblast — regional services, local ordinances, or regional enforcement practice — appears in the sources reviewed.
outOfScopeNotes: The UK Home Office country policy and information note on sexual orientation and gender identity and expression for Russia (June 2025) states expressly that it contains no information specific to the Jewish Autonomous Oblast. The Human Rights Watch extremism-designation figures of 30 June 2025 are national totals and do not disaggregate the oblast. Whether the oblast's authorities enforce the national statutes at a rate above or below the national average is not sourced.
